reviews.title: My favorite habit tracker
reviews.text: I initially downloaded Flora as a recommendation from a friend and had pretty mid expectations. I’ve tried focusing on flight and other pomodoro timer apps, but flora is truly phenomenal. They don’t limit anything like most trackers I’ve used and I’ve found that the guilt of killing a tree has been a huge factor in my ability to stay focused. If I one day have a little more money I would like to contribute towards planting actual trees. In the meantime, this app has been so hopeful in reigning myself in and I’m happy to recommend it to any other students who struggle with their attention as well.

reviews.text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I really like Focus Flora and I use it basically every day. It helps me study, focus on my work, and get other things done. I really like how simple and helpful the app is.

One thing I wish Focus Flora had is dark mode. Sometimes using the app for a long time, especially at night, can feel a little bright. Having dark mode would make it more comfortable to use and would give people another option for how they want their app to look.

Overall, I really like Focus Flora and I think adding dark mode would make the app even better! 💗

Pros:
• Helps me study and focus
• Easy to use
• I can use it every day
• Helps me get things done

Cons:
• No dark mode yet
• The bright screen can be uncomfortable at night

Rating: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5

reviews.title: Love it(w/ flaws)
reviews.text:
Despite becoming a sinner if you use Flora (you CAN bet/gamble cashmoney or bits), it helps me tremendously focus on my study materials by disallowing the use of other apps, unless i exclude it (ex: phone). If you don’t allow the phone app to be excluded while you use Flora and someone calls you, it’ll force Flora to close and you’ll lose the cashmoney or bits that you bet on your study time. Even if you don’t gamble, it frequently forces itself closed and you lose your time. However, the Flora team is really helpful with refunding your lost bet if they can see on their end that the app forced itself closed. 

Overall? Install it. There’s issues but more beneficial than not. it elevates your ADHD compulsion to complete tasks by accomplishing goals with earned study time and showing you plants from around the workd you can plant. Earn enough time and you can plant a real tree. Happy studying!:) -Louisiana

reviews.title: LOVE but has a problem
reviews.text: I absolutely love flora! The concept is great, and I love the idea of supporting a cause while improving my own study habits. The app also allows users the create to-do lists and categories (which I use to separate my classes), so you can see your progress for each respective course. There are also fun widgets, a variety of plants, and beautiful designing! However, this is a problem that leaves me incredibly frustrated!! Sometimes when I start a new focus and end it, the time it shows I study doesn’t match the actual amount of time I spent on the focus! For example, I spent an hour studying for my chem exam, but when I finish growing my plant, it shows I only studied for 1 minute!!!! It’s a small problem that occurs approximately 1-2 times a week, but it does make me very upset, especially since I’m trying to reach a certain goal each week. Other than this issue, it’s a great free study app, the best one I’ve tried!

reviews.title: New update changed it
reviews.text: I LOVED this app! I got a boost of dopamine every time I finished my studying and grew a tree, and I loved the little anticipation I got when wondering what kind of tree I was growing. It helped me SO so much with executive dysfunction and eliminating distractions. I was recommending it to everyone I knew and it was awesome. However, the new update has completely changed it for me, and now i pretty much stopped using it entirely. I don’t like the new layout and style and I don’t like the monetary system to ‘purchase’ the trees. The interphase when navigating the different journeys/tours is super confusing and unintuitive. I usually don’t mind change, but this seems like a different app and there isn’t any motivation for me anymore to use it. I’m sure someone who didn’t know the app before the update would love it, but for right now, it just makes me sad

reviews.title: Always Helpful!
reviews.text: I have really enjoyed Flora for a long time, particularly with its simple nature. It is so easy to implement into your life, yet surprisingly effective. I especially enjoy how, if you undershoot the time, you can effectively create a ‘stop-watch’ for when you aren’t entirely sure of how long the task is going to take. I’m sure that was not it’s original purpose—it was probably just there to reward those who focused for longer than they originally planned—but it’s been helpful for me for my writing projects, when I want to lock in but also gauge how long I’ve worked. Great app!
